# Hyperiux Vault

> Hyperiux Vault is a curated library of 115 creative interaction effects and UI components for React and Next.js - scroll systems, cursor effects, text reveals, page transitions, WebGL scenes, animated backgrounds, buttons, and loaders. Effects are previewed live on the site and installed into projects via the `hyperiux-components` CLI.

Hyperiux Vault is built by Hyperiux Immersion Labs. Free effects can be installed by anyone with a free account; Pro effects require a Hyperiux Pro subscription. Every effect ships as real source code (React components using GSAP, Motion, Three.js, or CSS) that developers own and customize - not a locked-in package import.

Key facts:
- Website: https://vault.hyperiux.com
- Install CLI: `npx hyperiux-components add <effect-name>`
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/hyperiux-components
- GitHub: https://github.com/Hyperiux-Immersion-Labs/hyperiux-components
- Stack: React, Next.js, GSAP, Motion (Framer Motion), Three.js / React Three Fiber

## Docs

- [Documentation home](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs): Overview of how the Vault and CLI work
- [Installation](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs/installation): How to install effects with the CLI
- [CLI reference](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs/cli): Commands, Pro authentication, and tokens
- [Dependencies](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs/dependencies): Peer dependencies effects rely on (GSAP, Motion, Three.js)
- [License](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs/license): Usage terms for free and Pro effects

## Effects by category

- [All effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects): Browse and search the full library
- [Text animations](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/text-animations): Scramble, mask, overflow, blur, fill, spotlight, and reveal effects for real HTML text
- [Scroll effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/scroll-effects): Scroll-driven animations for product stories, feature tours, and portfolio chapters
- [Cursor effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/cursor-effects): Custom cursors, followers, and pointer-reactive interactions
- [Page transitions](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/page-transitions): Route and view transitions for Next.js apps
- [WebGL effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/webgl-effects): Three.js and shader-based scenes, galleries, and hero visuals
- [Backgrounds](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/backgrounds): Dotted grids, particle fields, and dithered canvas textures for SaaS and AI heroes
- [Buttons](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/buttons): Accessible CTA microinteractions - staggered labels, arrow fills, scramble links
- [Navigation](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/navigation): Menus, navbars, and navigation interactions
- [Carousels](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/carousels): Clip-path reveals and zoom sliders with swipe and keyboard support
- [Loaders](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/loaders): Page loaders and progress animations
- [Components](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/components): Composite UI components and sections
- [Featured](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/featured): Curated picks selected for craft and brand impact
- [Free effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/free): Effects available on the free plan
- [Pro effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/pro): Premium effects unlocked with a Pro subscription

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://vault.hyperiux.com/pricing): Free plan and Hyperiux Pro subscription (monthly, quarterly, yearly) with full vault and CLI access
